anomalies.observed: Both sides of each isolated CAN transceiver are connected to the same GND net; the CAN connector ground pins are on that net as well.
anomalies.expected: The transceiver logic-side and bus-side grounds should remain separate to preserve the galvanic isolation described for the CAN interfaces.
anomalies.impact: The shared ground bypasses the transceivers’ isolation barriers, so the CAN interfaces are not galvanically isolated and may no longer provide the intended ground-loop and fault protection.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: both ground pins on each isolated CAN transceiver share the same GND net, which defeats the specified CAN isolation.
